content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following educational and experience criteria: Educational Qualification: Pass in X Standard, and a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent in Indian Navy from a recognized University/Institute/Examination Board. Equivalency certificate is required for equivalent qualifications. Experience: Essential: Minimum 15 years of post-qualification experience in operation, maintenance, and watchkeeping of marine equipment and systems on Indian Naval Surface Ships / Submarines as an Ex-Indian Navy personnel. Desirable: Knowledge of propulsion systems fitted on Naval Surface Ships / Submarines, equipment, administrative procedures of the Indian Navy, Marine Main Engines, Gearboxes, Auxiliary machineries (Air Conditioning, Refrigeration, HVAC, Sewage Treatment, Oily Water Separator, PGD systems, weapon equipment, sensors, deck machineries), and proficiency in computer-based data management & record keeping. Restriction: Only Ex-Indian Navy Personnel shall apply. The post is not identified as suitable for PwBDs.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 1,00,000/- for the first year, Rs. 1,03,000/- for the second year, and Rs. 1,06,090/- for the third year. The contract tenure is for a period of three years and is extendable for a further period of two years subject to organizational requirements and individual performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Cochin Shipyard Guarantee Engineer
content_sections.text: Go to the link Official Website (Career page -> Cochin Shipyard, Kochi) to read the User Manual and FAQ. Access the SAP Online portal via the Cochin Shipyard website to complete the One-time Registration and submit the application between 12 October 2026 and 30 October 2026. Upload all required certificates for proof of age, educational qualification, experience, discharge certificate/book/PPO from the Indian Navy, and a recent passport size colour photograph. Remit the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 400/- (plus bank charges extra) using online payment options (Debit card, Credit card, or Internet Banking) if applicable. SC/ST candidates are exempted. Verify all entries, submit the application successfully, ensure the status shows as "In process", and retain a soft copy or printout of the application containing the unique registration number.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection method is through a Personal Interview out of 100 marks. Candidates must successfully complete certificate verification before attending the Personal Interview. Cochin Shipyard may shortlist candidates based on eligibility requirements ascertained from uploaded certificates. The rank list is prepared based on marks secured in the Personal Interview, with seniority in age deciding relative merit in case of ties.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is purely on contract basis for a period of three years, extendable for a further period of two years.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only Ex-Indian Navy personnel who have passed X Standard, hold a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent in Indian Navy, and possess a minimum of 15 years of relevant post-qualification experience are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee exemption?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) are exempted from payment of the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: CSL shortlists candidates based on meeting eligibility requirements ascertained through the certificates uploaded in the online application portal, followed by certificate verification and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit and cut-off date?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 56 years as on 30 October 2026, meaning applicants must be born on or after 31 October 1970.
